title: Farm Size, Technical Efficiency, and Environmental Performance: Evidence From Rice Production in China
abstract: Farm size, as well as technical and environmental efficiency in agriculture, is key to food security and sustainable development. However, empirical evidence about how heterogeneity across farm sizes is associated with the joint production of desirable outputs and undesirable by‐products remains limited, preventing our understanding of technical and environmental efficiency. Using country‐representative survey data on rice production in China from 2014 to 2018, we estimate farm‐level technical and environmental efficiency by employing a by‐production function combined with a stochastic meta‐frontier approach, accounting for heterogeneous technology across farm sizes. Our findings reveal considerable room to improve both technical and environmental performance, and the extent of both differs markedly by farm size. Medium‐sized farms (2–6.67 ha) exhibit the highest meta‐frontier technical efficiency, whereas large farms (6.67–33.33 ha) achieve the highest meta‐frontier environmental efficiency. The estimated shadow prices indicate that the mean marginal abatement cost of nitrogen pollution is 129.233 yuan/kg. We also identify a range of farm‐scale factors, such as technical training, land consolidation, higher educational attainment, and cooperative membership, which are significantly associated with higher levels of technical and environmental efficiency in rice farming. Counterfactual simulations further indicate that combining farm‐size‐specific measures could enhance meta‐frontier technical and environmental efficiency. In particular, cooperative participation is positively associated with technical and environmental performance among smallholders, while high‐level education and technical training are more impactful at large farms. Land fragmentation is consistently associated with lower efficiency and wider technology gaps across farm sizes. Our findings underscore the importance of designing farm‐size‐specific policies and implementing integrated interventions in promoting sustainable agricultural development.
abstract_zh: 农场规模以及农业中的技术效率和环境效率，对粮食安全和可持续发展至关重要。然而，关于不同农场规模之间的异质性如何与合意产出和非合意副产品的联合生产相关联的经验证据仍然有限，这妨碍了我们对技术效率和环境效率的理解。本文利用2014至2018年中国水稻生产的全国代表性农户调查数据，结合副产品生产函数与随机元前沿方法，估计农场层面的技术效率和环境效率，并考虑了不同农场规模间技术的异质性。我们的研究发现，技术效率和环境绩效均有较大的改进空间，且两者在不同农场规模之间的差异十分显著。中等规模农场（2—6.67公顷）的元前沿技术效率最高，而大型农场（6.67—33.33公顷）的元前沿环境效率最高。估计的影子价格表明，氮污染的平均边际减排成本为每公斤129.233元。我们还识别出一系列农场层面的因素，如技术培训、土地整合、较高的受教育程度以及合作社成员身份，这些因素与水稻种植中较高的技术效率和环境效率显著相关。反事实模拟进一步表明，结合针对不同农场规模的措施，可以提高元前沿技术效率和环境效率。特别地，合作社参与与小农户的技术和环境绩效呈正相关，而高水平教育和技术培训对大型农场的影响更大。土地细碎化在各农场规模中始终与较低的效率和更大的技术差距相关。我们的研究结果强调，设计因农场规模而异的政策并实施综合干预措施，对于促进农业可持续发展具有重要意义。

title: Global Agricultural Value Chains and Food Prices
abstract: We study the relationship between the extent of participation in global agricultural value chains (GAVCs) and food prices at the country level. Using longitudinal data on a sample of 138 countries for the period 2000–2015 and a shift‐share instrumental variable design, we study how the extent of a country's participation in GAVCs in a given year relates to food price levels and volatility in that same country and in the same year. We document a mean–variance trade‐off, finding that on average, participation in GAVCs is associated with a decrease in consumer food price levels but an increase in food price volatility. Looking at a country's upstream (i.e., closer to producers) or downstream (i.e., closer to consumers) positioning in GAVCs, we find that food price volatility is associated more strongly with downstream participation than with upstream participation.
abstract_zh: 我们在国家层面研究全球农业价值链（Global Agricultural Value Chains，GAVCs）参与程度与食品价格之间的关系。利用138个国家在2000至2015年间的纵向数据，并采用份额—转移（shift-share）工具变量设计，我们考察了一个国家在特定年份参与GAVCs的程度与同一国家、同一年份食品价格水平和价格波动之间的关系。我们记录了一种均值—方差的权衡：平均而言，参与GAVCs与消费者食品价格水平下降相关，但与食品价格波动加剧相关。考察一国在GAVCs中的上游（即更靠近生产者）或下游（即更靠近消费者）位置后，我们发现，食品价格波动与下游参与的关联比与上游参与的关联更为密切。

abstract_zh: 粮食长期以来一直是治国方略的工具。然而，农业经济学通常通过消费者和生产者福利的视角来分析政策，忽视了安全方面的外部性。我们回顾了农业经济学与政治学交叉领域的文献，考察粮食体系如何通过两个渠道既塑造又受制于地缘政治力量：(a)具有国际溢出效应的国内不稳定，以及(b)有意将粮食用于治国方略。我们对文献中主要发现的综合表明：(a)粮食价格与骚乱和不稳定相关，但与内战和暴力的关系并不明确；(b)农业地理分布之广，相较于其他战略部门，限制了但并未消除单边胁迫杠杆的作用；(c)国内粮食政策与国家安全目标密切相关。此外，我们指出了可用于该领域研究的众多现有数据集，并找出了文献中若干研究空白。随着全球不确定性加剧，将地缘政治分析纳入农业经济学对于增强政策相关性至关重要。

Pesticide Regulatory Heterogeneity, Foreign Sourcing, and Global Agricultural Value Chains
abstract: Regulations on the production and consumption of goods are very heterogeneous across countries. Whereas the effects of regulations on exports are well known, the responses of importers to heterogeneous and frequently changing country‐specific regulations are not well understood. We combine Swiss firm‐level import customs transaction data with country‐product‐year‐specific maximum residue limits to investigate the effect of pesticide regulatory heterogeneity on firm‐level imports and assess the moderating role of firm size and global value chain participation. Relying on a global sourcing model, we find that regulatory heterogeneity reduces imports but less so in larger and diversified firms. Participating in global value chains also improves firms' flexibility toward heterogeneous regulation. Business diversification—although reducing the gains from trade and scale—could help firms cope with heterogeneous international regulations.
abstract_zh: 各国对商品生产和消费的监管差异很大。虽然监管对出口的影响已广为人知，但进口方对异质且经常变动的国别监管的反应，尚未得到充分理解。我们将瑞士企业层面的进口海关交易数据与国家—产品—年份层面的最高残留限量相结合，考察农药监管异质性对企业层面进口的影响，并评估企业规模和全球价值链参与的调节作用。基于全球采购模型，我们发现，监管异质性会减少进口，但对规模较大且业务多元化的企业影响较小。参与全球价值链也提高了企业应对异质监管的灵活性。业务多元化虽然减少了贸易利益和规模效应，但有助于企业应对国际监管的异质性。

title: A linear model to estimate modal split in international freight transport, based on revealed preferences about cost and time saving
Does it matter how we ship the good apples out? On specific tariffs, transport mode, and agricultural export prices
abstract: Free‐on‐board (FOB) export prices for identical products from the same origin often differ across destinations, even when accounting for the trade costs and attributes of the destination country. One explanation for this observed price difference is per‐unit trade costs, and the ability of exporters to vary their markups and/or product quality. Using a novel dataset that details trade flows between countries by mode of transport, we estimate the transport mode‐specific effect of a per‐unit trade cost, specifically specific tariffs, on the FOB export prices of agricultural products. We find an elasticity of specific tariffs to export prices of 1.8%. However, the estimates are heterogeneous across modes of transport. The elasticity of specific tariffs to export prices is 2% for air transport, 5% for road transport, and  .3% for sea cargo. Since the observed positive export price effect can reflect product quality differences or markups, we account for the quality element and find that for a given product quality, markups increase with increasing specific tariffs. This form of price discrimination is less pronounced for higher‐quality products that are predominantly shipped by air.
abstract_zh: 来自同一产地的相同产品，即使在考虑了贸易成本和目的国特征之后，其离岸价（Free-on-Board，FOB）出口价格在不同目的地之间仍常常存在差异。对这一观察到的价格差异的一种解释是单位贸易成本，以及出口商调整加成率和/或产品质量的能力。我们利用一个详细记录各国之间按运输方式划分的贸易流量的新数据集，估计了单位贸易成本（具体而言为从量关税）对农产品FOB出口价格的运输方式特定效应。我们发现，从量关税对出口价格的弹性为1.8%。然而，估计结果在不同运输方式间存在差异：航空运输的从量关税对出口价格弹性为2%，公路运输为5%，海运货物则为0.3%。由于观察到的出口价格正向效应可能反映产品质量差异或加成率，我们对质量因素加以控制，发现在给定产品质量的情况下，加成率会随着从量关税的提高而上升。对于主要通过航空运输的高质量产品，这种价格歧视的形式不那么明显。

title: On the palm oil - biodiversity trade-off: Environmental performance of smallholder producers
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Oil palm remains an important source of rural income in South East Asia. At the same time, Indonesia has become a hotspot for large-scale species extinction and a loss of biodiversity in favour of agricultural production. The present study sets out to assess the environmental performance of smallholder oil palm production with respect to biodiversity. Using a panel dataset that combines conventional farm data together with an account of plant diversity, we estimate a restricted hyperbolic environmental distance function. We integrate loss of biodiversity as an undesirable output into the production model which allows explaining shortfalls in environmental performance and the derivation of shadow prices of biodiversity conservation. We find a substantial environmental inefficiency, which is partly explained by both chemical and manual weeding practices, highlighting the potential for improvements in both the environmental and the economic dimension. Moreover, the value for conserving one species of the average biodiversity on a farmers plantation was 325 USD in 2018. Payments for ecosystem services schemes could be a viable policy response to conserve meaningful levels of biodiversity while simultaneously allowing smallholders to increase palm oil output. In general, addressing drivers of environmental performance in PES designs amplifies its effect without reducing output.
abstract_zh: 油棕在东南亚农村收入中仍然是一个重要来源。与此同时，印度尼西亚已成为大规模物种灭绝和生物多样性丧失的热点地区，这是为了农业生产而造成的。本研究旨在评估小农油棕生产在生物多样性方面的环境绩效。我们利用一个结合了常规农场数据与植物多样性记录的面板数据集，估计了一个受限的双曲线环境距离函数。我们将生物多样性丧失作为非合意产出纳入生产模型，从而能够解释环境绩效的不足，并推导出生物多样性保护的影子价格。我们发现存在大量的环境非效率，部分原因在于化学除草和人工除草的做法，这表明在环境和经济两方面都有改进的潜力。此外，2018年，在农民种植园中保护一种物种（以平均生物多样性水平计）的价值为325美元。环境服务付费计划可能是一种可行的政策应对，既能保护有意义水平的生物多样性，又能使小农增加棕榈油产量。总体而言，在PES设计中解决环境绩效的驱动因素，可以在不减少产出的情况下放大其效果。

title: The future of research on sustainable food systems: Building an early-career network of agricultural economists in Europe
Environmental efficiency and greenhouse gas abatement costs of dairy farms from Minas Gerais, Brazil
Technical efficiency and farmland expansion: Evidence from oil palm smallholders in Indonesia
abstract: This study asks whether innovation in smallholder production reduces or accelerates land expansion. Even though innovation in agriculture has reduced land expansion globally, rebound effects can occur locally and often at the expense of vital ecosystem functions. In contrast to other studies that investigate rebound effects in response to technological innovation, our study focuses on technical efficiency, the remaining component of total factor productivity. We use a short panel dataset from smallholder oil palm farmers in Sumatra, Indonesia, and develop a two‐stage approach in which we estimate technical efficiency and determine its land expansion effect. Our findings suggest that technical efficiency and in particular land efficiency are low, indicating that 50% of the currently cultivated land could be spared. However, the land‐sparing effect of increasing technical efficiency is at risk of being offset by about half due to a rebound effect. To maximize the conservation potential from increasing smallholder efficiency, policies need to simultaneously incentivize well‐functioning land markets and stricter protection measures for land with high ecological value to mitigate local rebound effects.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨小农生产中的创新是减少还是加速了土地扩张。尽管农业创新在全球范围内已降低了土地扩张，但反弹效应在局部地区仍可能出现，且往往以牺牲重要的生态系统功能为代价。与其他研究技术创新所引发反弹效应的文献不同，本研究聚焦于技术效率，即全要素生产率中剩余的组成部分。我们使用印度尼西亚苏门答腊岛小农油棕农户的短期面板数据，并构建了一个两阶段方法：先估计技术效率，再确定其对土地扩张的影响。研究发现，技术效率，尤其是土地效率，处于较低水平，表明目前耕种的土地中有50%可以得以节省。然而，提高技术效率所产生的土地节约效应，有将近一半因反弹效应而被抵消的风险。为了最大化提高小农效率所带来的保护潜力，政策需要同时激励运行良好的土地市场，并对具有高生态价值的土地实施更严格的保护措施，以减轻局部的反弹效应。

title: The effect of cognitive function on the poor's economic performance: Evidence from Cambodian smallholder farmers
abstract: Despite manifold policy interventions, poverty still exists. Those most harshly affected are people living in rural areas of low‐income countries. A seminal strand in the literature presents a promising avenue for analyzing the lives of the poor by suggesting that poverty impedes cognitive function. However, the real‐world consequences of impeded cognitive function are yet to be discovered. We ask whether the level of cognitive function can help to explain the differences in economic performance of the poor. We conducted a field study in rural Cambodia using the well‐established Raven's Progressive Matrix to elicit cognitive function. Employing stochastic frontier analysis, we find that the level of cognitive function of poor smallholder farmers helps in explaining differences in economic performance. Our findings suggest that impeded cognitive function results in a negative economic performance feedback loop, which can be a reason why some farmers appear to be stuck in poverty while others manage to escape it.
abstract_zh: 尽管各种政策干预已经实施，贫困依然存在。受贫困打击最为严重的，是低收入国家农村地区的居民。文献中的一条重要脉络提出，贫困会损害认知功能，这为分析穷人的生活提供了一个有前景的视角。然而，认知功能受损在现实中的后果尚有待揭示。我们探讨认知功能水平能否解释穷人经济绩效的差异。我们在柬埔寨农村开展了实地调查，使用成熟的瑞文渐进矩阵（Raven's Progressive Matrices）测量认知功能。采用随机前沿分析，我们发现，贫困小农的认知功能水平有助于解释其经济绩效的差异。我们的研究结果表明，认知功能受损会导致负向的经济绩效反馈循环，这可能是部分农民陷入贫困而另一些人却能够摆脱贫困的原因。
